comment: Source windows for the film. Durations are whole multiples of 6 frames so every cut lands on the same 0.2s grid and the eye can build a pulse without music. Two shots that share a window are cut from ONE continuous take, so the match cut between them is literally the same footage carrying on.

herdA.note: shots 1+2 — one continuous take; the pane the film opens on is the pane inside the phone

changesA.note: shots 6+7 — the review act, one take on paper

connection.note: shot 10 — pinned to the held tail of the flow, not the liveliest moment: this shot is a claim rather than an action, and the lively part is a scroll that carries the machine owner's relay host into frame. review/leakcheck.mjs enforces it.

herdB.note: shot 11 — the spaces list, where 16 agents is on screen. Pinned rather than found: the scorer picks the liveliest window and the scale reveal needs a specific one.
